# NOSOCOMIAL SINUSITIS

Nasogastric tubes increase the risk of bacterial sinus infection associated with Staphylococcus aureus, streptococcus, and gram-negative bacilli, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Aspirate sinuses for gram stain and culture to direct antimicrobial therapy. Adequate sinus drainage is vital to treatment.

References:
Chow et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases. 2012, 54(8) e72-e112
